notes: New barrier plate in the ParkingYou house style: navy PY-Blauw field, white plain P (no roof, not a garage), aqua dividers, Dutch line in Ubuntu Bold white, English line in Ubuntu Regular PY-Aqua, white tow away pictogram, white horizontal logo. ASSUMPTION: trim 1000 x 200 mm is estimated from the photo of the blank mounting plate (about 5 : 1). The plate hangs in front of the boom and is screwed to it in the lower part: all content stays above y 146 mm, the navy part below holds the three screws (whole plate is PY-Blauw) (group mounting-holes, magenta rings, not printed; positions x 123, 555 and 917 mm at y 164 mm are estimated from the photo). Measure plate and screw positions before ordering, then change TRIM and HOLES in build.py and rebuild. Material proposal: 3 mm aluminium dibond, printed and laminated, double sided if the plate is seen from both approaches.
